chunks: Then surely upon Us is their reckoning.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that the reckoning is upon Allah in Surah Al-Ghashiyah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores Allah's exclusive right to exact retribution, distinguishing His direct accountability from the delegated role of angels or prophets. It reinforces the concept of divine justice (Adl), where the Creator personally oversees the precise measurement of deeds, ensuring no aspect of the disbelievers' actions escapes His knowledge.
